levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن عبد الله بن أحمد الرازي

notes: the chain is the book's own transmission of Dawud al-Raqqi's narrations, opening و ما كان فيه عن داود الرقي فقد رويته (the compiler's words, not written)
the second saying, و روي عن الصادق عليه السلام أنه قال, has no transmitter before the Imam; it is a separate saying (rule 11, two sayings in one report), so the Imam is not added to this route
